name: Eight
source:
She woke up in a strange place without a name or clear memories, but since she convinced herself she's in a dream she's quite composed. Eight is quiet, but she draws her strength from protecting others. Since she dislikes reaching out to people, her brother is her best friend. She enjoys watching romantic dramas with him. Eight is terrified of small, cramped places and the idea of death.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31401]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real name is Ember.[/spoiler]
